summary: Rolled back billing-api, catalog-svc, edge-gateway, pricing-svc, search-api and session-svc to healthy releases. I made an error on auth-api: a rollback call whose output was cut off had actually taken effect, and status was stale, so I retried and rolled back a second time to b-7 (commit bc71bab, created 2026-09-02, before the 2026-09-10 cutoff); the status view still shows r-101 degraded, so auth-api's real state needs manual verification and correction. orders-api (403 Forbidden) and notify-worker (only older-than-cutoff release available) were left degraded.
